title: Attention over paged KV caches in Triton: page writes (BF16, FP16, FP8, INT8), split-KV decode and verify windows merged by their log-sum-exps, causal prompt chunks, and flash structures (grouped heads packed into tensor-core tiles, contiguous KV splits) for windows and prompt chunks, and a CUDA flash tile (queries in shared memory, 16 rows a warp) for both

write.what: a step's keys and values into their page slots in one launch, one program per token and KV head, encoded for the page kind (exact: the same codes and scales whatever the warps)

WARPS.what: warps a program (0: one up to 128 values a head, two past)

yardstick.library: FlashInfer append_paged_kv_cache into the same slots (the pool as pages of one position), 16-bit pages only: no library encodes FP8 or INT8 pages

split.what: how a row's keys split over the KV partitions of every split-KV launch over a cache (decode, verify windows, fused prompt rows, block lists): positions a piece and the partition count, piece i to partition i mod P; one value each per cache, read by partitions() and piece_size()

PIECE.what: positions a piece (0: 16,384 head values over 16-bit pages, 8,192 over FP8 and INT8, within 16..128)

PARTS.what: KV partitions a row (0: about 1.5 programs per SM over FP8 and INT8 pages, 0.75 over 16-bit, a power of two within 8..128)

yardstick.library: FlashInfer BatchDecodeWithPagedKVCacheWrapper (tensor-core kernels, any query heads a KV head) over the same rows and page tables, its own KV split; per-position-scaled FP8 and INT8 pages widened once to BF16 (FlashInfer reads 16-bit pages and FP8 pages with one scale a layer)

window.what: the split-KV window launch: a query tile of a row's columns times a KV head's query heads over the pieces of one partition, mma.sync on every GPU (tile_for's tile), its partials written for the merge

WARPS.what: warps a tile (0: two up to 32 rows, four over a 64-row tile); a tile of 64 rows or more keeps the rule's on GPUs with warpgroup MMA

STAGES.what: pipeline stages of a piece's loads (0: three up to 32 rows, four over a 64-row tile)

yardstick.library: FlashInfer BatchPrefillWithPagedKVCacheWrapper, causal, over the same rows' columns and page tables (BatchDecode for one column); per-position-scaled FP8 and INT8 pages widened once to BF16 (FlashInfer reads 16-bit pages and FP8 pages with one scale a layer)

merge.what: the merge after a split launch: one program per column and query head folding its partitions' partials in partition order (elementwise: its warps and the partials loaded a turn change no bits)

CHUNK.what: partitions whose partials a merge program loads a turn (at most the partitions' power of two), folded one by one

yardstick.library: FlashInfer BatchPrefillWithPagedKVCacheWrapper over the same windows, as window's: the merge is timed in the whole attend call it closes, FlashInfer's split and merge inside its call; per-position-scaled FP8 and INT8 pages widened once to BF16 (FlashInfer reads 16-bit pages and FP8 pages with one scale a layer)

fused.what: the fused window launch (prompt rows as windows of up to 64 columns): each program reads every partition of its tile in turn and folds them as the merge does, over a part of the value columns: the split launch's bits, no partials

WARPS.what: warps a tile; a tile of 64 rows or more keeps the rule's on GPUs with warpgroup MMA

STAGES.what: pipeline stages of a piece's loads

VSPLIT.what: programs a tile, each over a part of the value columns and computing the scores again (0: two past 128 value columns, else one)

yardstick.library: FlashInfer BatchPrefillWithPagedKVCacheWrapper, causal, over the same windows; per-position-scaled FP8 and INT8 pages widened once to BF16 (FlashInfer reads 16-bit pages and FP8 pages with one scale a layer)

sparse.what: the block-sparse launch: one program per token, partition and KV head over the positions of the token's listed KV blocks, partials merged as the window launch's

WARPS.what: warps a program; a tile of 64 rows or more keeps the rule's on GPUs with warpgroup MMA

STAGES.what: pipeline stages of a piece's loads

yardstick.library: FlashInfer BatchDecodeWithPagedKVCacheWrapper over page lists holding exactly each token's listed blocks (the same keys in the softmax); per-position-scaled FP8 and INT8 pages widened once to BF16 (FlashInfer reads 16-bit pages and FP8 pages with one scale a layer)

prefill.what: a causal prompt chunk of one sequence: a block of queries over blocks of its positions in one online softmax (FP32 row sums), through its page table; INT8 queries on integer tensor cores over INT8 pages with int8_qk

BLOCK_M.what: queries a program (speed only under mma.sync; on GPUs with warpgroup MMA another tile may take another instruction)

BLOCK_N.what: positions a step of the online softmax (0: 64 up to 128-wide heads, 32 past)

WARPS.what: warps a program (on GPUs with warpgroup MMA the instruction follows them)

STAGES.what: pipeline stages of a block's loads (0: three with int8_qk, else two)

yardstick.library: FlashInfer BatchPrefillWithPagedKVCacheWrapper, causal, the chunk over its sequence's page table; BF16 queries (FlashInfer has no INT8 query path); per-position-scaled FP8 and INT8 pages widened once to BF16 (FlashInfer reads 16-bit pages and FP8 pages with one scale a layer)

flash-window.what: the flash window launch (attend(..., flash=True)): a row's columns times a KV head's query heads packed into tiles of the cache's one shape (ROWS x WARPS), the row's keys in contiguous splits of CHUNK positions walked in blocks of BLOCK_N with the online softmax on the tensor cores (base 2, FP32 row sums), every block masked (one rounding for every block), the splits merged in split order; CHUNK, BLOCK_N, ROWS and WARPS one per cache for every flash launch over it (flash_chunk(), flash_block(), flash_tile())

CHUNK.what: positions a split (0: 1,024), a multiple of BLOCK_N

BLOCK_N.what: positions a step of the online softmax (0: 32)

ROWS.what: rows a tile, columns times query heads (0: 32); GPUs with warpgroup MMA keep one 64-row four-warp tile

STAGES.what: pipeline stages of a block's loads (0: one past 128-wide heads, two up to them)

yardstick.library: FlashInfer BatchPrefillWithPagedKVCacheWrapper, causal, over the same rows' columns and page tables (BatchDecode for one column); per-position-scaled FP8 and INT8 pages widened once to BF16 (FlashInfer reads 16-bit pages and FP8 pages with one scale a layer)

flash-fused.what: the fused flash launch (attend(..., flash=True, fused=True), prompt rows as windows of up to 64 columns): each program walks every split of its tile in turn and folds them in split order as the flash merge does, over a part of the value columns, in the cache's tile: the flash window launch's bits, no partials

STAGES.what: pipeline stages of a block's loads (0: one past 128-wide heads, two up to them)

VSPLIT.what: programs a tile, each over a part of the value columns and computing the scores again (0: two from 128 value columns, else one)

yardstick.library: FlashInfer BatchPrefillWithPagedKVCacheWrapper, causal, over the same windows; per-position-scaled FP8 and INT8 pages widened once to BF16 (FlashInfer reads 16-bit pages and FP8 pages with one scale a layer)

flash-prefill.what: the flash prompt chunk (prefill(..., flash=True)): the chunk's tokens times a KV head's query heads packed into tiles, its positions split on the device over SPLITS programs a tile (merged by their states) or read in one range (written directly), blocks a tile sees in full without the causal mask, exp2 with the scale folded in, FP32 row sums; a token's bits follow the chunk's length

BLOCK_M.what: rows a tile, tokens times query heads (0: 32)

STAGES.what: pipeline stages of a block's loads (0: one past 128-wide heads, two up to them)

SPLITS.what: programs a tile's positions split over (0: about two programs an SM, at most 64; 1: one range, no merge)

yardstick.library: FlashInfer BatchPrefillWithPagedKVCacheWrapper, causal, the chunk over its sequence's page table; BF16 queries (FlashInfer has no INT8 query path); per-position-scaled FP8 and INT8 pages widened once to BF16 (FlashInfer reads 16-bit pages and FP8 pages with one scale a layer)

cuda-window.what: the CUDA flash tile's window launch (attend(..., flash="cuda"), cuda_window.cu): a row's columns times a KV head's query heads in tiles of 16 rows a warp, the queries in shared memory (ldmatrix a k-step), the row's keys and values in blocks of BLOCK_N through a cp.async ring the CTA's warps share, BF16 mma.sync with FP32 accumulators, each warp's online softmax in registers (no cross-warp reduction), contiguous splits of CHUNK positions merged in split order; CHUNK and BLOCK_N one per cache for every cuda launch over it (cuda_chunk(), cuda_block()), the warps change no bit

CHUNK.what: positions a split (0: the GPU's rule, a decode row of 90,112 positions over two programs an SM, its KV heads counted by their square root: 90,112 x sqrt(KV heads) / (2 x SMs) to the nearest 128, 128 to 2,048), a multiple of BLOCK_N

BLOCK_N.what: positions a step of the online softmax (0: 16 over 16-bit pages, 32 over 8-bit pages)

WARPS.what: warps a CTA, 16 query rows each (0: four; never more than the window's rows need): speed only, each warp owns its rows' softmax

STAGES.what: cp.async stages of a block's keys and values (0: one over 16-bit pages, the keys and values in buffers of their own, two over 8-bit pages; fewer where the GPU's shared memory does not hold them)

VWARPS.what: warps a row group of 16 query rows, sharing its scores (each computing some of a block's positions) and splitting its value columns (0: the rule with WARPS 0, as many row groups as the tile's query rows fill up to four and four warps in all; 1 with a tuning's WARPS): speed only, every warp of a group runs its softmax on the same scores

CONVERT.what: where 8-bit pages' codes become 16-bit operands: 1 a 16-bit block in shared memory the CTA converts once a block, 2 each warp's fragments in registers (0: the rule, registers; launches with fresh rows always the shared block): speed only, the same operands

RAMP.what: a row's first positions in RAMP bands of 16 splits (CUDA_RAMP_SPLITS), band b's of CHUNK / 2^(RAMP - b) positions, then splits of CHUNK (0: every split CHUNK positions): short rows in many small splits, long ones in about as many as without; one per cache for every cuda launch over it (cuda_ramp()), CHUNK a multiple of BLOCK_N x 2^RAMP

yardstick.library: FlashInfer BatchPrefillWithPagedKVCacheWrapper, causal, over the same rows' columns and page tables (BatchDecode for one column); per-position-scaled FP8 and INT8 pages widened once to BF16 (FlashInfer reads 16-bit pages and FP8 pages with one scale a layer)

cuda-fused.what: the CUDA flash tile's fused launch (attend(..., flash="cuda", fused=True), prompt rows as windows of up to 64 columns): the window launch's programs, one a split, each writing its state into a ring its tile owns, the last of a group of splits folding the group's states in split order with the merge's steps into the tile's running state, over VSPLIT parts of the value columns: the cuda window launch's bits, a workspace that follows the tiles, no partials a split; its block and chunk cuda-window's

WARPS.what: warps a CTA, 16 query rows each (0: four; never more than the window's rows need): speed only, each warp owns its rows' softmax

STAGES.what: cp.async stages of a block's keys and values (0: one over 16-bit pages, the keys and values in buffers of their own, two over 8-bit pages; fewer where the GPU's shared memory does not hold them)

VSPLIT.what: programs a tile, each over a part of the value columns and computing the scores again (0: one)

VWARPS.what: warps a row group of 16 query rows, sharing its scores (each computing some of a block's positions) and splitting its value columns (0: the rule with WARPS 0, as many row groups as the tile's query rows fill up to four and four warps in all; 1 with a tuning's WARPS): speed only, every warp of a group runs its softmax on the same scores

CONVERT.what: where 8-bit pages' codes become 16-bit operands: 1 a 16-bit block in shared memory the CTA converts once a block, 2 each warp's fragments in registers (0: the rule, registers; launches with fresh rows always the shared block): speed only, the same operands

yardstick.library: FlashInfer BatchPrefillWithPagedKVCacheWrapper, causal, over the same windows; per-position-scaled FP8 and INT8 pages widened once to BF16 (FlashInfer reads 16-bit pages and FP8 pages with one scale a layer)

cuda-prefill.what: the CUDA flash tile's prompt chunk (prefill(..., flash="cuda")): the chunk's tokens times a KV head's query heads in tiles of 16 rows a warp, its positions split on the device over SPLITS programs a tile (merged by their states) or read in one range (written directly); a token's bits follow the chunk's length

WARPS.what: warps a CTA, 16 query rows each (0: four; never more than the window's rows need): speed only, each warp owns its rows' softmax

STAGES.what: cp.async stages of a block's keys and values (0: two; fewer where the GPU's shared memory does not hold them)

SPLITS.what: programs a tile's positions split over (0: about two programs an SM, at most 64; 1: one range, no merge)

yardstick.library: FlashInfer BatchPrefillWithPagedKVCacheWrapper, causal, the chunk over its sequence's page table; BF16 queries (FlashInfer has no INT8 query path); per-position-scaled FP8 and INT8 pages widened once to BF16 (FlashInfer reads 16-bit pages and FP8 pages with one scale a layer)
